# Prepare variables
data_pilot <- data_pilot %>%
  mutate(
    fish_id = factor(fish_id),

    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),

    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),

    # Recalculate body-mass change from the original measurements
    mass_change_g = body_mass2 - body_mass1,

    mass_change_percent = (
      (body_mass2 - body_mass1) / body_mass1
    ) * 100,

    # Standardised pre-injection body mass
    body_mass_before_sc = as.numeric(scale(body_mass1))
  )
# Check variable structure

Body mass - Analysis

# Convert body mass data to long format
mass_long <- data_pilot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    fish_id,
    treatment,
    treatment_plot,
    body_mass1,
    body_mass2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(body_mass1, body_mass2),
    names_to = "time",
    values_to = "body_mass"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("body_mass1", "body_mass2"),
      labels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  )

# Inspect the long-format dataset
head(mass_long, 10)
## # A tibble: 10 × 5
##    fish_id treatment treatment_plot time   body_mass
##    <fct>   <fct>     <fct>          <fct>      <dbl>
##  1 03LPS3  LPS       LPS            Before    0.156 
##  2 03LPS3  LPS       LPS            After     0.128 
##  3 04LPS4  LPS       LPS            Before    0.241 
##  4 04LPS4  LPS       LPS            After     0.233 
##  5 05LPS5  LPS       LPS            Before    0.127 
##  6 05LPS5  LPS       LPS            After     0.105 
##  7 07LPSC6 PBS       PBS            Before    0.144 
##  8 07LPSC6 PBS       PBS            After     0.136 
##  9 09LPSC4 PBS       PBS            Before    0.0932
## 10 09LPSC4 PBS       PBS            After     0.0917
# Confirm the number of observations
dim(mass_long)
## [1] 78  5
# Confirm that each fish has two measurements
table(table(mass_long$fish_id))
## 
##  2 
## 39
# Mean body mass by treatment and time
mass_long %>%
  group_by(treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
## # A tibble: 6 × 5
##   treatment time       n   mean     sd
##   <fct>     <fct>  <int>  <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 NI        Before     7 0.0974 0.0423
## 2 NI        After      7 0.0946 0.0376
## 3 PBS       Before    13 0.102  0.0411
## 4 PBS       After     13 0.0965 0.0382
## 5 LPS       Before    19 0.104  0.0416
## 6 LPS       After     19 0.0964 0.0387
# Log-transform body mass
mass_long <- mass_long %>%
  mutate(
    log_body_mass = log(body_mass)
  )

# Visualise the transformed variable
hist(
  mass_long$log_body_mass,
  main = "Log-transformed body mass",
  xlab = "log(body mass)",
  col = "grey80",
  border = "white"
)

# Final log-transformed model retaining the interaction
m_mass_log_final <- lmer(
  log_body_mass ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id),
  data = mass_long,
  REML = TRUE
)

# Inspect the final model
summary(m_mass_log_final)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]
## Formula: log_body_mass ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id)
##    Data: mass_long
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -75.2
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -1.83138 -0.39931 -0.00296  0.36868  1.92892 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  fish_id  (Intercept) 0.132615 0.36416 
##  Residual             0.001054 0.03246 
## Number of obs: 78, groups:  fish_id, 39
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                        Estimate Std. Error       df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)            -2.41418    0.13819 36.28491 -17.470  < 2e-16 ***
## timeAfter              -0.01369    0.01735 36.00000  -0.789  0.43519    
## treatmentPBS            0.05825    0.17140 36.28491   0.340  0.73591    
## treatmentLPS            0.09195    0.16165 36.28491   0.569  0.57299    
## timeAfter:treatmentPBS -0.03689    0.02152 36.00000  -1.714  0.09513 .  
## timeAfter:treatmentLPS -0.05886    0.02030 36.00000  -2.900  0.00633 ** 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) tmAftr trtPBS trtLPS tA:PBS
## timeAfter   -0.063                            
## treatmntPBS -0.806  0.051                     
## treatmntLPS -0.855  0.054  0.689              
## tmAftr:tPBS  0.051 -0.806 -0.063 -0.043       
## tmAftr:tLPS  0.054 -0.855 -0.043 -0.063  0.689
# Overall tests
anova(
  m_mass_log_final,
  type = 3
)
## Type III Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
##                  Sum Sq  Mean Sq NumDF DenDF F value    Pr(>F)    
## time           0.034362 0.034362     1    36 32.6099 1.694e-06 ***
## treatment      0.000161 0.000080     2    36  0.0762   0.92677    
## time:treatment 0.009023 0.004512     2    36  4.2816   0.02147 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Simulated residuals
res_mass_log <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_mass_log_final,
  n = 1000
)

# General diagnostic plot
plot(res_mass_log)

# Individual diagnostic tests
testUniformity(res_mass_log)

## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.081385, p-value = 0.6798
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
testDispersion(res_mass_log)

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 0.94981, p-value = 0.892
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
testOutliers(res_mass_log)

## 
##  DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate
##  expectations
## 
## data:  res_mass_log
## outliers at both margin(s) = 0, observations = 78, p-value = 1
## alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.001998002
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.00000000 0.04619242
## sample estimates:
## frequency of outliers (expected: 0.001998001998002 ) 
##                                                    0
# Residuals by treatment
plotResiduals(
  res_mass_log,
  form = mass_long$treatment
)

# Residuals by time
plotResiduals(
  res_mass_log,
  form = mass_long$time
)

# Final body-mass model
# Writing log() directly allows emmeans to back-transform the results
m_mass_log_final <- lmer(
  log(body_mass) ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id),
  data = mass_long,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m_mass_log_final)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]
## Formula: log(body_mass) ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id)
##    Data: mass_long
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -75.2
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -1.83138 -0.39931 -0.00296  0.36868  1.92892 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  fish_id  (Intercept) 0.132615 0.36416 
##  Residual             0.001054 0.03246 
## Number of obs: 78, groups:  fish_id, 39
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                        Estimate Std. Error       df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)            -2.41418    0.13819 36.28491 -17.470  < 2e-16 ***
## timeAfter              -0.01369    0.01735 36.00000  -0.789  0.43519    
## treatmentPBS            0.05825    0.17140 36.28491   0.340  0.73591    
## treatmentLPS            0.09195    0.16165 36.28491   0.569  0.57299    
## timeAfter:treatmentPBS -0.03689    0.02152 36.00000  -1.714  0.09513 .  
## timeAfter:treatmentLPS -0.05886    0.02030 36.00000  -2.900  0.00633 ** 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) tmAftr trtPBS trtLPS tA:PBS
## timeAfter   -0.063                            
## treatmntPBS -0.806  0.051                     
## treatmntLPS -0.855  0.054  0.689              
## tmAftr:tPBS  0.051 -0.806 -0.063 -0.043       
## tmAftr:tLPS  0.054 -0.855 -0.043 -0.063  0.689
# Estimated marginal means for time within each treatment
emm_mass_log <- emmeans(
  m_mass_log_final,
  ~ time | treatment
)

# Results on the original body-mass scale
summary(
  emm_mass_log,
  type = "response"
)
## treatment = NI:
##  time   response      SE   df lower.CL upper.CL
##  Before   0.0894 0.01240 36.3   0.0676    0.118
##  After    0.0882 0.01220 36.3   0.0667    0.117
## 
## treatment = PBS:
##  time   response      SE   df lower.CL upper.CL
##  Before   0.0948 0.00961 36.3   0.0772    0.116
##  After    0.0901 0.00914 36.3   0.0734    0.111
## 
## treatment = LPS:

##  After    0.0912 0.00765 36.3   0.0769    0.108
## 
## Degrees-of-freedom method: kenward-roger 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## Intervals are back-transformed from the log scale
# After-to-before ratio within each treatment
mass_change_log <- contrast(
  emm_mass_log,
  method = list(
    "After / Before" = c(-1, 1)
  )
)

# Back-transform the estimates into ratios
summary(
  mass_change_log,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "sidak"
)
## treatment = NI:

WBC

# WBC model
m_wbc <- glmmTMB(
  wbc ~ treatment + body_mass_before_sc,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = data_pilot
)

# Inspect the model
summary(m_wbc)
##  Family: Gamma  ( log )
## Formula:          wbc ~ treatment + body_mass_before_sc
## Data: data_pilot
## 
##      AIC      BIC   logLik deviance df.resid 
##    382.1    390.4   -186.0    372.1       34 
## 
## 
## Dispersion estimate for Gamma family (sigma^2): 0.198 
## 
## Conditional model:
##                     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)          3.85425    0.16930  22.766  < 2e-16 ***
## treatmentPBS         0.01840    0.20975   0.088  0.93011    
## treatmentLPS         0.75891    0.19830   3.827  0.00013 ***
## body_mass_before_sc  0.05828    0.07747   0.752  0.45188    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Overall tests of treatment and initial body mass
Anova(
  m_wbc,
  type = "II")
## Analysis of Deviance Table (Type II Wald chisquare tests)
## 
## Response: wbc
##                       Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)    
## treatment           27.3038  2  1.178e-06 ***
## body_mass_before_sc  0.5659  1     0.4519    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Simulate residuals from the WBC model
res_wbc <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_wbc,
  n = 1000
)

# General diagnostic plot
plot(res_wbc)

# Test residual uniformity
testUniformity(res_wbc)

## 
##  Exact one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.11054, p-value = 0.6862
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
# Test overdispersion or underdispersion
testDispersion(res_wbc)

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 1.2338, p-value = 0.42
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# Test for an unusual number of outliers
testOutliers(res_wbc)

## 
##  DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate
##  expectations
## 
## data:  res_wbc
## outliers at both margin(s) = 0, observations = 39, p-value = 1
## alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.001998002
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.0000000 0.0902511
## sample estimates:
## frequency of outliers (expected: 0.001998001998002 ) 
##                                                    0
# Residuals by treatment
plotResiduals(
  res_wbc,
  form = data_pilot$treatment
)

# Residuals in relation to initial body mass
plotResiduals(
  res_wbc,
  form = data_pilot$body_mass_before_sc
)

# Model convergence checks
m_wbc$fit$convergence
## [1] 0
m_wbc$sdr$pdHess
## [1] TRUE
# Estimated marginal means for WBC
emm_wbc <- emmeans(
  m_wbc,
  ~ treatment,
  at = list(
    body_mass_before_sc = 0
  ),
  type = "response"
)

emm_wbc

## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## Intervals are back-transformed from the log scale
# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons
wbc_comparisons <- pairs(

)

summary(

# N:L ratio model
m_nl <- glmmTMB(

)

# Inspect the model
summary(m_nl)

## Formula:          nl_ratio ~ treatment + body_mass_before_sc
## Data: data_pilot

##      AIC      BIC   logLik deviance df.resid 
##   -108.1    -99.7     59.0   -118.1       34 
## 
##

## 
## Conditional model:
##                     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)         -2.51756    0.21383 -11.773  < 2e-16 ***
## treatmentPBS        -0.28991    0.26587  -1.090  0.27553    
## treatmentLPS         0.75370    0.24998   3.015  0.00257 ** 
## body_mass_before_sc  0.04076    0.09189   0.444  0.65736    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Overall tests of treatment and initial body mass
Anova(
  m_nl,

)

##  expectations

)

# Estimated marginal means for each treatment

# Display estimated means on the original N:L-ratio scale
summary(

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Prepare model estimates and positions for the letters
nl_letters_plot <- nl_letters %>%
  dplyr::select(
    treatment,
    treatment_plot,
    response,
    asymp.LCL,
    asymp.UCL,
    .group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    nl_raw_max,
    by = "treatment_plot"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    letter_y = pmax(
      asymp.UCL,
      raw_max
    ) + 0.035
  )


# Check the final plotting table
nl_letters_plot
##   treatment treatment_plot   response  asymp.LCL  asymp.UCL .group raw_max
## 1        NI   No injection 0.08065610 0.04840557 0.13439377      a   0.124
## 2       PBS            PBS 0.06035732 0.04145308 0.08788264      a   0.138
## 3       LPS            LPS 0.17138268 0.12569422 0.23367839      b   0.462
##    letter_y
## 1 0.1693938
## 2 0.1730000
## 3 0.4970000
# N:L ratio figure
p_nl_pilot <- ggplot(
  data_pilot,
  aes(
    x = treatment_plot,
    y = nl_ratio
  )
) +

  # Raw-data boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = treatment_plot),
    width = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.35,
    colour = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  # Individual observations
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = treatment_plot),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.10,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    alpha = 0.70,
    size = 2.2
  ) +

  # Model-estimated means and 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    data = nl_letters_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      ymin = asymp.LCL,
      ymax = asymp.UCL,
      colour = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = nl_letters_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      y = response,
      fill = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.5,
    stroke = 1.1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # Significance letters
  geom_text(
    data = nl_letters_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      y = letter_y,
      label = .group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = dark_cols
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pastel_cols
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(6),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.03, 0.12)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Neutrophil:lymphocyte ratio"
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 13,
      colour = "grey25"
    )
  )


# Display the figure
p_nl_pilot

# Save figure
ggsave(
  here("figures", "pilot_nl.ratio.pdf"),
  p_nl_pilot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  here("figures", "pilot_nl.ratio.jpg"),
  p_nl_pilot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
